bio: Matteo Tabrizzi, once a humble facchino of Persian descent, has remarkably ascended to the ranks of the Cittadini through his extraordinary business acumen and property investments. Beginning as a porter in Venice's bustling markets, Matteo transformed his position through shrewd real estate dealings, particularly his lucrative property on Calle de la Fava in San Marco which generates substantial lease income. His rise represents a rare success story of social mobility in Renaissance Venice. Tho
